work_dir.description: The directory where MRTG stores its log files and generated images.

targets.description: A list of target definitions to be monitored via mrtg-ping-probe. Each item is an object with the following fields: name, host, description, max_bytes, abs_max, y_legend, short_legend, legend_1, legend_2, legend_3, legend_4, legend_i, legend_o. name: A unique identifier for the target (e.g., 'myserver.ping'). host: The IP address or hostname to ping. description: A short description for the interface (e.g., 'ping'). max_bytes: The maximum value for the Y-axis scaling, typically 100 for ping latency. abs_max: The absolute maximum value for the Y-axis, typically 200. y_legend: The text displayed on the Y-axis legend. short_legend: The unit label (e.g., 'ms'). legend_1: Description for the first legend line (Max RTT). legend_2: Description for the second legend line (Min RTT). legend_3: Description for the third legend line (Max 5-min RTT). legend_4: Description for the fourth legend line (Min 5-min RTT). legend_i: Label for Input data (Max). legend_o: Label for Output data (Min).
